claims.sentence: The purpose of this study is to analyze the effect rosuvastatin 20 mg on the metabolism of triglyceride rich lipoproteins and HDL in patients with Type 2 diabetes using and in vivo kinetic study of VLDL1-apoB,VLDL2-apoB,IDL-apoB and HDL-apoA1.
